callouts.label: Assess
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents assess.
callouts.description: Notice the current situation, strengths, needs, resources, and constraints.
callouts.ap_tip: Use observations and credible information. Assessment is a snapshot, not a judgment.

callouts.label: Clarify Values
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents clarify values.
callouts.description: Connect the goal to what matters personally.
callouts.ap_tip: Meaning supports motivation better than outside pressure alone. Different people can choose different priorities.

callouts.label: Set the Goal
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents set the goal.
callouts.description: Define a specific, meaningful, realistic result and review point.
callouts.ap_tip: Focus on behavior or function rather than worth. Keep the goal within the person’s influence.

callouts.label: Choose Small Actions
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents choose small actions.
callouts.description: Break the goal into practical next steps.
callouts.ap_tip: Shape the environment to make actions easier. Start small enough to repeat.

callouts.label: Build Support
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents build support.
callouts.description: Identify people, services, tools, and settings that can help.
callouts.ap_tip: Ask for specific support. A plan should not depend on willpower alone.

callouts.label: Track Observations
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents track observations.
callouts.description: Record useful signals such as completion, energy, barriers, mood, function, or context.
callouts.ap_tip: Track only what helps learning. Protect privacy and avoid obsessive monitoring.

callouts.label: Reflect
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents reflect.
callouts.description: Review what worked, what did not, and why.
callouts.ap_tip: Separate the result from self-worth. Look for patterns rather than one difficult day.

callouts.label: Adapt Around Barriers
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents adapt around barriers.
callouts.description: Change timing, steps, supports, environment, or the goal when barriers appear.
callouts.ap_tip: Some barriers require system-level solutions. Adaptation is a skill.

callouts.label: Revise or Continue
callouts.hint: Find the scene that best represents revise or continue.
callouts.description: Continue, expand, pause, or choose a new goal based on evidence and values.
callouts.ap_tip: Celebrate learning and meaningful progress. The loop can begin again.
